messages:
tess: opened a PR to add Seoul + Hong Kong rows to the Regions page and a short 'what to expect' migration checklist. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/976
omar: good. legal asked we replace 'data residency' mentions with 'data processing region' and add a brief export-control note.
tess: swapped wording and added a footnote referencing the compliance page. left a TODO for a console screenshot.
rebecca: I'll wire up a tiny CLI example for region migration and a TS SDK snippet for selecting region + kms key. will keep it minimal.
legal-bot: Reminder: customers in certain APAC jurisdictions may require additional export-control review. See internal doc: https://redwood-internal/legal/export-controls
docs-ci: PR #976 preview available: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/regions/976 (build OK)
tess: QA ask: someone skim staging for absolutes like 'data never leaves the region'. If present, replace with 'processed and stored in the selected region unless cross-region features are enabled.'
rebecca: pushed snippets and added a small troubleshooting note for "region mismatch" errors in the Console. Example CLI:
```bash
redwoodctl project set-region --project myproj --region asia-east2
```
omar: added footnote clarifying Private/on-prem availability is by arrangement in some APAC locations and linked the Private deployments matrix.
tess: thanks—I'll merge once legal confirms wording. I'll also add a 1-line item to the docs weekly about the update. :memo:
